data.description:
## Description

Story `20d7-09d6-b831-4c3a` (under epic b575) deleted `.github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml` (commit `4b18d2d644`, task `398c-9d6c-1fd5-4b39`) to satisfy an epic-internal invariant ('exactly one llm-review pipeline per SHA' needed by cycle-ledger story 5621, arbiter dispatch story b1b6, max_cycles enforcement story 35b8).

The deleted workflow provided the project's per-story / per-batch internal LLM review surface — the SUB-PR review tier that the user has repeatedly identified as load-bearing for reliable review of large epics.

## Scope violation

The epic's stated goal (b575) is cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification — adding cycle-ledger, arbiter rulings, parity between local and PR. **It is NOT scoped to remove existing review coverage.** Deleting per-branch-review.yml is a regression introduced because the new functionality interfered with the old, not because the old functionality was wrong.

Two architectural choices were available to honor BOTH invariants:
- (preserved) restore per-branch-review.yml with ledger-aware deduplication (cycle ledger keyed by PR + SHA, not SHA alone)
- (preserved) adapt ci.yml's llm-review to fire on sub-branch-targeted PRs too, sharing the same ledger reconstruction surface

Story 20d7 took the destructive path instead.

## Compounding failure: known gap was misclosed

Story 20d7's completion-verifier caught the gap immediately and filed bug `0091-0cf9-3840-4b00` ("debug-everything ci-pr mode sub-branch PRs get zero LLM review after per-branch-review.yml deletion"). Bug 0091 was CLOSED via commit `4c730cf6db` that only edited `debug-everything/SKILL.md` to point at `/dso:review` — a skill that is HARD-GATED to no-op under `dso.workflow=ci-pr` (review/SKILL.md:13-23). The "fix" was documentation-only and pointed at a code path that does not run in production mode.

Bug 0091 also failed to mention sprint's per-story PRs at all — which have the same gap.

## Impact

- Sprint's per-story PRs run ZERO internal LLM review (PRs #227, #228 in this session demonstrate the bypass).
- Debug-everything's per-batch PRs run ZERO internal LLM review.
- The user's intended workflow ("every change must pass review before merge to main; sub-PRs review smaller subsets") is structurally broken.
- The only remaining internal LLM review fires at session→main on the cumulative diff — the exact large-diff scenario the user has explicitly said is unreliable.

## Why this is P0

- The user has repeatedly stated that EVERY change must pass review before merging to main.
- This is the SECOND critical workflow regression in this epic (see companion P0 bug e486-2d01).
- The epic's stated success criteria say "parity local+PR" — but the deletion REDUCED PR-side review coverage to less than parity.
- Pattern: stories that interfere with existing functionality are deleting the existing functionality instead of reconciling. This is destructive in a way the user cannot anticipate from the epic title.

## Suggested remediation

1. Open a follow-on story in epic b575 (or successor) to RESTORE per-sub-PR internal LLM review. Architectural options:
   - Re-add per-branch-review.yml with a ledger-aware version (ledger keyed by PR + SHA, not SHA alone), OR
   - Adapt ci.yml's llm-review `if:` filter to ALSO fire on PRs targeting session branches, with the same ledger-aware keying.
2. Re-open bug `0091-0cf9-3840-4b00` and re-classify: the documentation-only closure does not address the gap.
3. Audit all 5 closed bugs in epic b575 referencing per-branch-review.yml (0091, 49dc, cde6, d947, dfaf) to confirm none of them silently accept the coverage regression.

## Process guardrail

Stories that delete existing user-visible functionality (CI workflows, skills, commands, configuration knobs) must be flagged for explicit user confirmation BEFORE the story is implemented, regardless of whether the deletion is technically justified by epic invariants. Epic invariant convenience is not authorization to remove unrelated functionality.

## Related
- Companion P0 bug: e486-2d01-9443-40ac (fix-bug implements features without confirmation).
- Original deletion task: 398c-9d6c-1fd5-4b39.
- Original story: 20d7-09d6-b831-4c3a.
- Misclosed gap bug: 0091-0cf9-3840-4b00.
data.title: Story 20d7 deleted per-branch-review.yml — unrelated functionality removed for epic invariant convenience (scope regression)
